title: KB Home Q3 FY2026 results — the quarter ended 2026-08-31, released after the close 2026-09-22, call 17:00 ET; the second builder demand read inside the 09-29 house-price corridor and the out-of-sample check on Lennar's
source: NEWS: the company's own 2026-09-08 release, read through a secondary because the primary is unreachable from this runner. Verbatim, dateline "LOS ANGELES, Sept. 8, 2026": "KB Home (NYSE: KBH) today announced that it will release earnings for its third quarter ended August 31, 2026 after the market closes on Tuesday, September 22, 2026" and "A live webcast of the Company's earnings conference call will be held the same day at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time, 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time." Read at stocktitan.net/news/KBH/kb-home-to-release-2026-third-quarter-earnings-on-september-22-1x0155wzfj9x.html (HTTP 200, 2026-09-16), which reproduces the release text; the same headline and date are carried by nasdaq.com's press-release mirror (fetch timed out at 60s, not read). THE PREFIX IS DOWNGRADED IR: -> NEWS: ON PURPOSE, per the honesty rule in docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md: investor.kbhome.com/ returns HTTP 403 to this runner (5,453 bytes, re-probed with the contactable UA 2026-09-16), investor.kbhome.com/press-releases 301-redirects, and www.kbhome.com/investor-relations returns 404 — three failed paths, all recorded in the proposing ledger's probe-ref.blocked, none silently substituted. The discovering sweep (case-shiller-hpi-2026-09-29, 2026-09-16) hit the same 403 and DECLINED to file this event on the record because it could not pin the date; this proposal exists because the date IS now pinned, on the company's own words, through a route that sweep did not try. Checked 2026-09-16
notes: DISCOVERED during lennar-q3-fy2026-2026-09-16's initial research (2026-09-16). WHY IT IS ADJACENT TO THE PROPOSER, specifically and not decoratively: the proposer's whole quantitative finding is that LEN's modern-era earnings gap is asymmetric — 3 up-gaps in 14 prints since 2023, mean -2.45%, p=0.029 against LEN's own 52% overnight base rate — and its registered forward test argues that asymmetry is a MARGIN-COMPRESSION-REGIME artifact rather than a property of the name. A second large builder reporting the SAME quarter (ended 2026-08-31) six days later is the out-of-sample check that claim needs, and it is the only one available before the 09-29 house-price corridor closes. KBH also carries the one number LEN's guidance frames the whole sector by: KB Home's own Q3 guidance is housing revenue $1.2B-$1.35B at a 16.0%-16.6% gross margin, against Lennar's ~16% guide and 12.9% realized incentive load — two independent reads on whether the compression is bottoming. FILED low AND sector, NOT earnings, on the costco-q4-fy2026-2026-09-24 and lennar-q3-fy2026-2026-09-16 precedents: KBH is not a tracked name, zero house playbooks key to it (re-grepped 2026-09-16 across trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md), market-events-types.ts forbids hand-entering kind `earnings`, and src/domain/earnings-calendar.ts is a file this lane may not edit. SYMBOLS carries ["KBH"] rather than [] — one company's print is not market-wide, and [] would leave the deterministic screen with no price to diff. INSIDE THE HORIZON LEASH (#2946) with room to spare: 6 days out, well under maxDaysOut 60 and under allImpactsWithinDays 30, so a `low` entry genuinely becomes due rather than being clutter that can never be assessed. CONSIDERED AND DECLINED, so the absences read as decisions: Lennar's own Q4 FY2026 print (quarter ending 2026-11-30, reporting ~January) sits past the 60-day horizon and is not filed; Toll Brothers' Q4 FY2026 (quarter ends 2026-10-31) likewise; and the NAHB HMI series needs nothing — 2026-10-19, 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-16 editions are already canonical. An estimate widens caution and licenses nothing; the proposer's own stance is stand-aside and is unchanged by this file.
